design_issues.screen: VendorBillingViews — New Vendor Bill dialog datalist#vb-pending
issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. The <option> children in the datalist have display:contents wrapper spans (likely from preview/instrumentation), causing a 'cannot be a child of' console error. Non-blocking but noisy. Consider rendering option text as plain string with no wrapper.

action_items: MINOR: The New Clause 'Delete' action uses a browser confirm() dialog which some automated tools cannot intercept reliably. Consider replacing window.confirm() with the shadcn AlertDialog for consistency with the rest of the app and to make delete deterministic in tests. (Backend delete works fine — only the UI confirm interception is flaky.)
MINOR: Suppress the hydration warning about <span> child of <option> in the vb-pending datalist inside VendorBillingViews.jsx (line ~270).
critical_code_review_comments: grn-prefill payload correctly surfaces vendor_name, GSTIN, PAN, MSME, bank_verified, PO number, project_code, line rates AND po_terms in a single call — good API design and avoids second round-trip on the UI.

Per-PO terms save endpoint uses id path param (8c47ad3a-…) and the toast message doubles as a UX contract ('will print on PO PDF & reflect on vendor bill entry') — worth adding a lightweight backend assertion test to guarantee PDF actually contains the saved terms strings (currently the test only checks PDF size & %PDF header because ReportLab compresses the stream — consider adding a plain-text terms fallback anchor to make it testable).
The amber PO Terms panel in the vendor-bill dialog is a great mismatch-prevention UI. Ensure it stays sticky if the user later changes the PO Number field manually — re-fetch terms accordingly.
